title: Xiao — Complete Character Guide & Talent Reference
summary: Complete reference for Xiao: 5-star Anemo Polearm user. Includes Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, Elemental Burst talent descriptions with scaling values, passive talents, all 6 constellation effects, and ascension material requirements.
content:
# Xiao — Complete Character Reference

## Overview
- **Name**: Xiao
- **Title**: Vigilant Yaksha
- **Rarity**: ★★★★★
- **Element / Vision**: Anemo
- **Weapon Type**: Polearm
- **Nation**: Liyue
- **Affiliation**: Liyue Adeptus
- **Constellation**: Alatus Nemeseos
- **Birthday**: 0000-04-17
- **Special Dish**: None

> A yaksha adeptus that defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

## Combat Talents

### Normal Attack: Whirlwind Thrust
Normal Attack
Perform up to 6 rapid strikes.
Charged Attack
Dive down and impact the ground, causing damage relative to the falling height. Can only be triggered in mid-air.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- 1-Hit DMG: 24% + 24%
- 2-Hit DMG: 50%
- 3-Hit DMG: 60%
- 4-Hit DMG: 33% + 33%
- 5-Hit DMG: 63%
- 6-Hit DMG: 84%
- Charged Attack DMG: 65%
- Height DMG: 130% / 195%

### Elemental Skill: Lemniscatic Wind Cycling
He lunges forward, dealing Anemo DMG to enemies along the path.
Can be used in mid-air.
Has 2 charges to begin with.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- Skill DMG: 229%
- CD: 10s

### Elemental Burst: Bane of All Evil
Takes on the form of the yaksha that terrified both demons and archons alike millennia ago. For its duration, increases Xiao's attack range and DMG, while converting damage type to Anemo and enhancing Xiao's jumping ability.
Maintaining this form continuously drains Xiao's HP.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- Increased DMG: 68.8%
- HP Loss: 3% HP/s
- Duration: 15s
- CD: 15s
- Energy Cost: 60

## Passive Talents

### Evil Conqueror - Tamer of Demons (Unlocked at Ascension 1)
Starting Bane of All Evil increases Xiao's DMG by 5%. After this, Xiao's DMG continues to increase by 5% every 3s until the skill ends. Max 25% increase.

### Dissolution Eon - Heaven Fall (Unlocked at Ascension 4)
When Lemniscatic Wind Cycling is used, increases all subsequent Lemniscatic Wind Cycling's DMG by 10% for 6s. Max 3 stacks. Duration refreshes with new stacks.

### Transcension - Gravity Defier (Unlocked Automatically)
Decreases all party member's falling DMG by 30%.
The greatest effect out of all Talents of the same type prevails.

## Constellations

### C1: Dissolution Eon - Destroyer of Worlds
Increases Lemniscatic Wind Cycling's charges by 1.

### C2: Annihilation Eon - Blossom of Kaleidos
When in party but not the currently active character, Xiao's Energy Recharge is increased by 25%.

### C3: Evil Conqueror - Wrath Deity
Increases the Level of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

### C4: Transcension - Extinction of Suffering
When Xiao's HP falls below 50%, gains a 100% DEF Bonus.

### C5: Evolution Eon - Origin of Ignorance
Increase the Level of Bane of All Evil by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

### C6: Evil Conqueror - Vigilant Yaksha
During Bane of All Evil, hitting 2 or more enemies with a Charged Attack grants Lemniscatic Wind Cycling 1 additional charge and reduces Lemniscatic Wind Cycling's CD by 1s.

## Ascension Materials

- **Level 40**: Mora ×40000, Vayuda Turquoise Fragment ×3, Juvenile Jade ×2, Qingxin ×10, Slime Condensate ×15
- **Level 50**: Mora ×60000, Vayuda Turquoise Fragment ×6, Juvenile Jade ×4, Qingxin ×20, Slime Secretions ×12
- **Level 60**: Mora ×80000, Vayuda Turquoise Chunk ×3, Juvenile Jade ×8, Qingxin ×30, Slime Secretions ×18
- **Level 70**: Mora ×100000, Vayuda Turquoise Chunk ×6, Juvenile Jade ×12, Qingxin ×45, Slime Concentrate ×12
- **Level 80**: Mora ×120000, Vayuda Turquoise Gemstone ×6, Juvenile Jade ×20, Qingxin ×60, Slime Concentrate ×24
